acceptance.shared_source_guard: reviewed v8 and mutation tests pass

allocation_source_companion.change: Relative to the accepted warm-start v6: version fields and fe/cmg.rs production token count, token digest and literal digest only. Reviewed literal changes are the trace field and grouping option value; allocation inventory, wiring, policy and exact F0 seams are unchanged. V7 preserves the rejected unconditional experiment; V8 adds the allocation-free weak-edge guard.

baseline: Preserved dirty main with worker-aligned batches and certified cross-frame nuisance guesses; not the clean base commit.
notes: Local macOS diagnostics only. All retained timings use the same final universal plugin against the preserved validated warm-start artifact.

Only prepared CMG with an actual nuisance block and all current canonical edges weak at both endpoints under the existing CMG 1/8 criterion sets low_effective_degree_threshold=0. The allocation-free test is recomputed each frame. This retains split heavy-edge aggregation without weak-edge pruning; fresh operators, PCG tolerances, residual checks, Schur rank policy, and all independent certificates are unchanged.

Direct factor-size, fill and depth bounds remain default, with identical conservative memory estimates for both grouping policies. Any strong edge, including equality at 1/8, keeps default pruning. OLS, two-FE and redundant-nuisance grouping remain default; solver(auto) remains MAP-only.

The direct-prototype experiment doubled the direct factor threshold with matching preflight. It passed science but lost total time to dense terminal factorization and was removed, not retained behind a policy switch.

The unconditional grouping prototype and its subsequent telemetry/test build passed science but regressed the mixed sparse-3FE nuisance32 probe: 0.380 to 0.489 seconds and four to six ordinary frames. This unguarded policy was removed. Only guarded-prefixed runs use the retained final artifact; all earlier receipts remain distinct.

Fine-graph PCG application counts exclude preconditioner and independent FE certificate work. Unpruned grouping can increase iterations while reducing total hierarchy traversal and elapsed time. Public iteration counts remain summed maximum-RHS counts.

Sparse CMG nuisance probes use the existing generator with an explicit third-FE width override, recorded in their scope IDs and data identities. They are additional diagnostics, not frozen-profile qualification.
No upstream repository, dependency pin, checkpoint authority, public solver surface, publication tolerance, sample or VCE/DoF semantics changed.
Initial unchanged-path timing outliers remain in the full sweep. Targeted reversed-order and nine-pair interleaved confirmations are additional evidence, not replacements for those receipts.
